blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — St. Luke’s Medical Center and the National Privacy Commission (NPC) are investigating a cybersecurity incident involving the hospital network’s mobile application that may have compromised personal information. NPC spokesperson and Deputy Privacy Commissioner Jose Belarmino II confirmed that the commission received a personal data breach notification from the hospital network on Oct. 30. READ: NPC warns: Misuse or leak of SALN data violates privacy law The NPC is now reviewing the incident.
